summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K to announce the election of Michael Huskins as an independent director and his appointment to the Audit Committee, effective August 17, 2026. The filing details his professional background and confirms no related-party transactions or family relationships. The board now has five members, with an Audit Committee of three independent directors. This is a routine governance update with no special-situation implications, such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic change. It does not constitute a management change of the CEO or CFO, nor any financial event, and is therefore classified as a routine current report.
